candidates.name: sectioned_case_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Separating event facts from conclusion and procedural material will improve aggregate accuracy over broad neighbor retrieval while using less context, because close factual analogies will be easier to compare.

candidates.name: answer_bundle_retrieval
candidates.hypothesis: Selecting demonstrations for diversity of joint answer bundles will improve aggregate accuracy over label-diverse demonstrations, especially when a correct output has multiple components.

candidates.name: answer_inventory_check
candidates.hypothesis: A frequency-ranked inventory of answer components from nearby verified examples will improve aggregate accuracy over a second-pass answer check by prompting completeness checks without discarding case-level evidence.
